description: Whitespace tolerance in decoding – surrounding spaces around delimiters and values

tests.name: tolerates spaces around comma, pipe, and tab delimiters in inline arrays
tests.input:
comma[3]: a , b , c
pipe[3|]: a | b | c
tab[3	]: a 	 b 	 c

tests.name: tolerates leading and trailing spaces in tabular row values
tolerates spaces around delimiters with quoted values
parses empty tokens as empty string
keeps a leading NBSP and a trailing tab in unquoted values
tests.note: Token trimming removes U+0020 only; NBSP and tab are part of the token

tests.name: preserves NBSP and tab around inline array tokens
tests.note: Token trimming removes U+0020 only; a host trim() that also strips NBSP or tab corrupts this round-trip

tests.name: decodes tabular rows with CRLF line terminators
keeps an escaped carriage return inside a quoted value
tests.note: Only a CR at the end of a line is part of the line terminator

tests.name: treats a carriage-return-only line as blank
strips a trailing carriage return at end of input
treats a hyphen followed by trailing spaces as the bare marker
tests.note: Trailing spaces are stripped before line classification

tests.name: keeps a second carriage return before CRLF as content
keeps a second leading byte-order mark as content
removes a byte-order mark before a comment line
